Korea's Kori 3 and 4 set for restarts in 2027
articles.원문 요약: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power has been given approval by South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission to continue operating Kori Nuclear Power Plant’s unit 3 and 4 for a further 10 years.

articles.제목: NVIDIA to consider data centres at former German nuclear sites
articles.원문 요약: Germany's PreussenElektra and multinational technology company NVIDIA are to explore whether PreussenElektra's former nuclear power plant sites are suitable for the construction of so-called AI factories.

articles.제목: Singapore looks to develop nuclear energy expertise
articles.원문 요약: The Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry and the Energy Market Authority of Singapore have launched schemes to develop "a strong pipeline of local expertise in nuclear energy".

articles.제목: Cross-party interest in Australian nuclear future, poll suggests
articles.원문 요약: A YouGov poll commissioned by grassroots organisation Nuclear for Australia suggests that almost two-thirds of Australians believe nuclear should be considered as part of the nation's energy future.
